content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, Thank you for providing the agreement. I am looking forward to getting started and would like to suggest a quick adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current wording excludes specific obligations from the overall liability cap. I propose updating this section so that in no event shall either party's total liability arising out of or related to the agreement exceed the amounts paid for the products in the preceding period, applying the cap universally. Please let me know if this adjustment is acceptable. Best regards,
